result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: inconsistent favorite-button styling on popular cards, a suspicious -100% promo badge, and bottom card content clipped by the tab bar.

issues.description: Favorite heart icon styling is inconsistent in 'Popular right now' section: Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a white outline heart with no background, while the pizza card below shows a white heart inside a dark circular scrim
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent favorite-button style with a semi-transparent dark circular background on all image cards to ensure visibility and consistency

issues.description: Second 'Popular right now' card displays a '-100%' badge, which looks like a broken discount calculation or placeholder value implying free food
issues.suggestion: Verify promotion logic and replace with correct discount value or remove the badge if no valid promotion exists

issues.description: Bottom pizza card in 'Popular right now' is flush against and clipped by the bottom tab bar, with no spacing and no restaurant name, delivery time or rating visible
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding and safe-area inset so cards scroll fully above the fixed Home/Search/Orders/Profile navigation
